# 8.2 implementation notes

- Fixture dates, explicit no-play weeks and starting times belong to the draw. No-play is never inferred to mean a holiday. Missing times remain unknown, including all-day ICS events. Melbourne DST is resolved per date into UTC; event IDs survive re-exports.
- Published TROLS competition points take precedence. The additional daytime codes must not inherit junior washout or forfeit rules. Colin and Lin Price Award remains excluded.
- Non-junior format metadata is derived from actual scorecards: singles/doubles slot counts, best-of lengths and six/eight/ten-game sets. Full deciding sets differ from match tiebreaks. Incomplete scores never become normal rating evidence.
- Following is a local, opt-in list keyed by competition + source season + section + identity. A new season cannot impersonate an old pinned entry. Historical entries remain snapshots. Fetch failures preserve the previous baseline. Notifications are in-site, on return, not push notifications.
- Share previews use the same canvas as PNG exports. No third-party screenshot service receives names or scores. Native share is only invoked after the user presses Share.
- Club Zone's next design has an unmounted template under web/future. Keep it disconnected until the logistics update is ready.

A useful interface is one where the next click is obvious. A useful developer note is one the developer actually reads. We have achieved at least one of those today.
